factor_name: Cross-sectional dual-horizon relative reversal, volatility scaled

calculation.description: Measures an asset's 60-day relative strength less its 10-day relative strength, scales by trailing 30-day volatility, and reverses the orientation. It favors assets whose medium-term relative leadership has recently faded, or whose recent burst is weak relative to the medium trend; negative raw predictive IC is explicitly handled by direction -1.
calculation.signal_artifact_expression: factor_value in scripts/miner_3_20340803_dual_horizon_reversal_signal.csv is the raw expression; production direction is -1

validation.regime_notes: Raw IC was negative in every reported post-2025 regime, so the persisted production direction is -1. Regime sample sizes are 408-784 dates where available. The 15-asset cross-section warrants conservative uncertainty interpretation.
validation.lookahead_control: Signals use closes through the signal date; forward returns begin after that date.
